jobs_results.title: Project manager LCS strategic projects
jobs_results.description:
Project manager LCS strategic projects page is loaded Project manager LCS strategic projects
Apply remote type Mobile Work locations San Fernando de Henares (Madrid) Neuburg an der Kammel Vienna time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago job requisition id JR101570 As Project Manager for the Life Cycle Services (LCS) department, you ensure the execution and global rollout of internal strategic projects. You will be the go-to person for everything involving a project’s organization and timeline. You are developing detailed project plans, ensuring resource availability and allocation, and delivering projects on time, within budget and scope.
Strategic projects revolve around enhancing our existing applications portfolio, which consist of the: CRM system (Salesforce), Field Service Management (SAP), electronic Spare Parts Catalogue as well as integrations towards MS Power BI, our IOT platform and many more. The current focus for this role will be to optimize our (after)sales and... service case management in Salesforce. Mid to long term, growth by involvement in other digitalization efforts is highly encouraged.
You will be part of a global team and manage stakeholders in both central management levels and local organizations. You are the driver and advocate of the Kardex Remstar Core Values in every interaction with vendors/suppliers & colleagues.

Your tasks
• Ensuring allocated projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget
• Coordinating internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of projects
• Consciously driving and managing change management
• Ensuring resource availability and allocation
• Manage change requests
• Ensure timely training for the end-users
• Report and escalate as needed
• Manage the relationship with all stakeholders
• Perform risk management to minimize project risks
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
• Organize and perform UAT and final testing
• Prepare lessons-learned meetings and report learnings back into the organization

Your profile
• Bachelor´s or master´s degree in economics, business management, financial management or equivalent professional education with several years of professional experience
• English CEFR Level B2 (advanced intermediate) or C1 (intermediate)Team player
• Proven multiple year experience with managing IT projects and applications
• Knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce) and interfacing to other systems
• Preferably have industrial experience in the production area / machine construction
• Additional languages such as German, Spanish, French, etc. are a big plus.

Automated storage solutions are high-tech. The basis for this is our genuine high-quality work from our own production sites, the skills of our specialists in planning, production, and assembly, as well as the innovative spirit of our engineers from research and development. For years, we have been developing solutions in the areas of Industry 4.0 and digitalization to offer our customers an excellent all-around service.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Propelland is a global strategy, design, and engineering firm helping companies transform and grow. We are a diverse group of thinkers, makers, hackers, and life-long learners tackling complex problems to improve people’s lives, with hubs in San Francisco, Madrid, Mexico City, Monterrey and Bogotá. Our talented and multidisciplinary teams have the privilege of working with Fortune 500 companies across industries and around the world. Small by design, we prefer to fly while others walk.

We are industry and solution agnostic, characterized by relentless curiosity. We work end-to-end beyond just research and strategy–covering everything from opportunity definition and discovery to MVP and go-to-market launch. To generate and implement innovative solutions, we partner with industry-leading clients and leverage our design thinking, business strategy, and engineering capabilities.
About the role:

As our Senior Data Project Manager, you will lead our data hub, focusing on Consumer Packaged... Goods (CPG) to enhance digital product performance through strategic data management and analysis. Your core mission involves translating data insights into actionable business strategies, backed by a deep understanding of data governance, quality management, and privacy standards. You will skillfully lead cross-functional teams, fostering seamless collaboration among data scientists, analysts, and IT specialists. The ideal candidate will be proficient in data analytics tools, project management software, and agile methodologies. If you are a strategic thinker passionate about leveraging data for impactful decisions, we encourage you to apply.
What you'll do:

– Lead the end-to-end management of digital product data, from briefing to performance analysis, providing valuable insights and recommendations for media, CRM, and design enhancements.

– Evangelize the importance of data within the organization, fostering a data-driven culture.

– Collaborate closely with technical teams for data development, integration, and ingestion into the data lake.

– Act as a facilitator, leveraging technology and data management expertise to improve data accuracy and timeliness.

– Collaborate with team members across different areas and geographies to enhance data governance processes.

– Analyze collected data to ensure accuracy and completeness.

– Support in generating business reports and analyzing digital KPIs.

– Engage daily with C-level clients, delivering proactive and insightful discussions.
Does this sound like you?

– Minimum 7 years of relevant experience.

– Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation, cleaning, and transformation.

– Deep understanding of data sources, visualization tools, and analytics, translating insights into business value.

– Knowledge of statistical analysis and predictive modeling tools for data optimization.

– Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik to create interactive dashboards and reports.

– Effective communication skills, teamwork, and customer orientation to understand business needs and present findings persuasively.

– Eager to learn new things, adaptability to change, and innovation to stay abreast of data analytics trends.

– Fluent in English; Colombian-based preferred, open to candidates based in Mexico or other South American countries.

– Be proactive and take ownership of tasks to drive project success.
Can't wait to meet us?

We are excited to get to know you and start the conversation about how we can grow together!

Click “Apply Here” and let’s start a journey of growth and transformation.

Propelland is an equal opportunity employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We put people front and center in everything we do and thrive on a diversity of personal experience, perspectives and backgrounds to help us do great things. Extraordinary work begins with extraordinary people.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Media.Monks is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead multiple projects, work streams and campaigns for an iconic automotive brand. Your well-rounded experience in the trenches allows you to accurately scope, quote, upsell and set up new projects comfortably, whilst actively steering client teams and mentoring your team. You understand the differences between creative, adaptation and always-on workflows, and know how to drive operational excellence and manage large structural changes whilst staying calm, poised and positive.
Role & Responsibilities
• Key point of contact for local client teams: you understand business KPIs and drive meetings, overall communications, and successful client relationships. You are the first point of contact for client escalations.
• You run several medium to large parallel projects independently, graciously steering clients and internal teams from end-to-end across multiple work streams.
• You create accurate and realistic project scopes and... budgets, and sense check those put together by more junior team members. You track project invoicing.
• Once a new job is awarded, you help to turn pitches into projects, liaising between our creatives and makers throughout the process.
• Conduct post-mortems with the client to improve the operations and communications on a continuous basis.
• Liaise with media agencies and external partners. Aligning across agencies to create fully integrated campaigns across all touch points.
• Build close-knit and trusted working relationships with clients, external agencies and internal teams.
• Brief legal, production and language & culture teams. Ensuring the team is clear on specs, deadlines, scope, and any client or local market requirements.
• Forecast and plan resources with great responsibility.
• Contribute to presentation and decks, and proactively flag opportunities to upsell services or increase scope of work.
• Support in the recruitment of new team members.
• Mentor, guide and help onboard Jr team members to the team.
Requirements
• 5+ years of experience in coordinating projects and teams for large multinational brands in creative production or agencies. Automotive experience is a strong plus, but not a must.
• Clear understanding of the full integrated production lifecycle and the difference between Creative, Social, Adaptation and Always-On work streams.
• Managing demanding clients and high complexity situations come naturally to you.
• Proven track-record working on integrated productions from TVCs and video, through to print and digital. You know how to work with media agencies, local clearance bodies, Legal, QA and Finance teams.
• Able to seamlessly safeguard quality, scope, timelines and budgets. You have a track-record of accurate and profitable estimates, and lead projects with great care, organisation and confidence.
• Team player and self-starter with an unbreakable positive mindset who comfortably takes the lead. You take charge and consistently showcase a strong sense of responsibility.
• Clear and strong communication skills in English, and any local language. Proactive and direct way of communicating across cross-cultural teams.
• An attentive, authentic and natural mentor, you create a fun team dynamic and make sure that successes are celebrated.
• A strong sense of urgency, you never leave problems unaddressed. Critical, curious and dare to speak up or push back.
• Able to delegate tasks efficiently without losing visibility, ownership and control.
• Steady rock in times of ambiguity and tight deadlines.
• Ambitious, gritty and resilient. Live for the hustle and enjoy a fast-paced environment.
• Quality standards are high and you motivate the bigger team to raise the bar non stop.

#LI-NB1

About Media.Monks:

Media.Monks is the purely digital operating brand of S4Capital plc that connects 8,600+ digital natives across one global team. We are united by a mission to shift industries forward and pave the path towards ambitious outcomes so our clients and our people can realize their full potential for growth. Our unified model combines solutions in media, data, social, platforms, studio, experience, brand and technology services to help our clients continuously reinvent themselves throughout increasingly rapid cycles of disruption. Our efforts to shape culture, build innovative technologies and unlock the future of growth have earned recognition from numerous esteemed panels: we maintain a constant presence on Adweek’s Fastest Growing lists (2019-22), regular recognition at Cannes Lions, inclusion in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players (2020-23), the title of Webby Production Company of the Year (2021-23), a record number of FWAs, and have earned a spot on Newsweek’s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces 2023. Together, these achievements solidify our experience in digital innovation, excellence in craft, and commitment to personal growth.

While we continue to grow our teams, please be mindful of fraudulent job postings and recruiting activities that may use our company name and information. Please be mindful to protect your personal information, especially your national identification number, and bank account information during a recruiting process. While Media.Monks may reach out to potential candidates via LinkedIn, we will always ask applicants to apply through our website ( ) and will never ask for payment or bank account information during the recruitment process.
Disclaimer:

Responsible that all your personnel apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy
